name: Heather Durham Nadler
tagline: Top rated Elder Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Heather Durham Nadler is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2027. She works at Nadler Biernath LLC, located in Atlanta, Georgia, and provides legal services for issues involving Elder Law and Estate Planning & Probate to the surrounding community.
Heather Nadler completed legal studies at Tulane University Law School and graduated with the class of 2000. Heather Nadler passed the bar in 2001.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
